what: Plan omits the current generic Step 3b “Continue to Step 4 IMMEDIATELY” prose path from the explicit retarget list, and the proposed harness check is region-token scoped enough to miss it.
scenario_or_breakage: If skills/design/SKILL.md:1340 remains as a direct Step 4 instruction, an orchestrator can skip the new FINALIZE completion-boundary fence; Step 4 then reads artifacts that FINALIZE would have created.
suggested_fix: Add the skills/design/SKILL.md:1340 continuation line to the retarget list and make the structure test fail any Step 3b line/block that says “continue to Step 4” unless that same continuation explicitly routes through the Step 3b completion boundary.
